Aker Solutions Appoints Paal Eikeseth as New CEO
Aker Solutions has appointed company insider Paal Eikeseth as its new chief executive immediately, succeeding Kjetel Digre, who has decided to step down after six years at the helm.

The Norwegian energy-industry service provider said Tuesday that  Eikeseth has headed the company's life cycle business since 2022 and had previously held responsibility for operations and growth in the U.K., Angola, Canada, and Asia.
